LanguageData.HD_Hemostasis_Reduction: Bleeding reduction on this body part: {0}
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_MenuDesc: Hemostasis takes 30 seconds on yourself or another friendly pawn, treating up to six of the most heavily bleeding parts without body-part exclusions. Temporary pressure starts after 20 seconds; completed dressings reduce local bleeding by 80% for 12 hours. Each part adds 5% pain, capped at 20%. Medic bag hemostasis also takes 30 seconds but retains its non-vital, four-part limit. Casualty tethers allow hands-free movement at reduced speed. Measured analgesics target 10% pain. A hemostatic agent takes 3 seconds and reduces systemic bleeding by 70% for 6 hours with blood pumping -10% and consciousness -5%; it combines with local dressings. MIST preparation takes 5 seconds.
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_NoPain: No additional analgesia is needed at the current pain level.
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_NoAnalgesic: No available Blanca's Drugs analgesic. Bring morphine, fentanyl, ketamine or laudanum in inventory, or leave a reachable dose on the map. The companion drug module must be active.
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_NoHemostatic: No reachable hemostatic agent. Make it at a drug lab or carry it in inventory.
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_CannotDrag: The casualty must be downed, adjacent and not already connected to another rescuer.
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_AnalgesicActive: An analgesic is already active. Wait until it wears off before using another measured dose.
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_DoseGiven: {0} received {2} of a standard dose of {1}.
